preconditions.description: The number of planets (nodes) must be between 1 and 100.
The number of wormholes (edges) must be between 0 and 10000.
The number of spaceships and bases must each be between 1 and 1000.
The cost of having a base attacked and the cost of creating a dummy base must be non-negative and not exceed 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in spaceship_locations) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in base_locations)
preconditions.description: All spaceship and base locations must be valid planet indices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum gold loss calculated based on the optimal number of dummy bases.
